relation: Advanced describes a higher or more complex level than a basic one.
sentence: After learning the controls of a basic model, she builds an advanced robot.（掌握基础模型的操作后，她开始制作一台高级机器人。）

scene.actor: One girl works at a table with a simple model and a more complex robot; only one person.
props: one advanced robot with several articulated parts
beats: She studies the simple model.
She uses what she learned to assemble the complex robot.
She finishes the advanced robot beside the basic model.
scene.ending: A girl compares her completed advanced robot with the simple basic model.

artDirection: Make the basic model simple and the advanced robot visibly more complex. No screens, writing, labels, letters, or numbers.

review.reviewNote: 句子自然；basic 与 advanced 是真实的程度对照，画面能表现复杂程度提升。

relation: Whatever the weather means that the action continues regardless of changing weather conditions.
sentence: Whatever the weather, he walks his dog every morning.（无论天气如何，他每天早晨都会遛狗。）

scene.setting: A quiet neighborhood path under an overcast morning sky.
scene.actor: One man walks one dog calmly in light rain; only one person and one dog.
beats: Clouds gather and light rain begins.
The man opens the umbrella and takes the dog outside.
They continue their usual walk despite the weather.
scene.ending: The man and dog walk on through light rain beneath the umbrella.

artDirection: Show one calm weather condition and a determined routine; no split panels, text, signs, or labels. Dog has exactly four legs.

review.reviewNote: 句子简洁自然，whatever the weather 表示不受天气影响，天气是具体锚点。

relation: A machine can help a worker produce more in the same amount of time, increasing productivity.
sentence: The factory’s productivity rises when one worker uses a new machine to assemble more chairs.（一名工人使用新机器组装更多椅子后，工厂的生产力提高了。）

scene.actor: One worker operates one simple assembly machine beside several finished chairs; only one person.
props: a small neat group of finished chairs
beats: The worker places a chair part in the machine.
The machine helps assemble chairs more quickly.
Several finished chairs stand ready, showing higher productivity.
scene.ending: The worker stands beside the machine and a neat group of finished chairs.

artDirection: No machine displays, labels, text, or numbers. Show one worker and one machine; finished chairs are a modest group, not a crowd of duplicates.

review.reviewNote: 句子自然，机器提高单位时间产出，生产力含义明确。

relation: A beautiful flower can be attractive because it draws people’s attention.
sentence: An attractive flower catches her eye as she walks through the garden.（她在花园散步时，一朵迷人的花吸引了她的目光。）

scene.setting: A quiet garden path in soft morning light.
scene.actor: One woman notices one unusually beautiful flower; only one person.
beats: The woman walks along the garden path.
She notices the colorful flower.
She pauses beside it, drawn to its attractive appearance.
scene.ending: The woman looks closely at the distinctive flower as a butterfly hovers nearby.

artDirection: Make one flower the clear focal point; no signs, labels, or text. Keep the butterfly anatomically natural.

review.reviewNote: 句子通顺，花的吸引力可视化，flower 是具体锚点。

relation: An octopus has exactly eight arms, providing a natural real-world anchor for the number eight.
sentence: An octopus has eight arms as it swims among the rocks.（一只章鱼在岩石间游动，身边伸展着八条腕足。）

scene.actor: One octopus swims above the seabed; only one animal.
props: one octopus with exactly eight arms
beats: The octopus glides over the seabed.
All eight arms spread around its body.
It swims among the rocks with each arm visible.
scene.ending: One octopus is shown with exactly eight separate arms fully visible among a few rocks.

artDirection: Count carefully: exactly eight arms total, each attached once to one octopus body; no extra tentacles, no duplicated animal, no letters or numbers. All eight arms must be fully visible and distinguishable.

review.reviewNote: 句子自然准确，章鱼的八条腕足提供真实且可画的数量锚点。

relation: An original sketch can be the first version made before a finished artwork.
sentence: The artist keeps the original sketch beside her finished painting.（艺术家把最初的草图留在完成的画作旁边。）

scene.actor: One artist compares an early sketch with the finished painting; only one person.
props: one simple pencil sketch on blank paper
beats: The artist looks at the first sketch.
She completes the painting based on it.
She keeps the original sketch beside the finished work.
scene.ending: The artist stands between the original sketch and the finished painting.

artDirection: The sketch and painting must contain only simple landscape imagery, no writing, signatures, letters, or numbers.

review.reviewNote: 句子自然，草图作为最初版本的熟悉锚点，original 义准确。

relation: A closed stage curtain creates expectation because the audience anticipates the show behind it.
sentence: A child watches the closed curtain in expectation of the puppet show.（一个孩子望着紧闭的幕布，期待木偶戏开场。）

scene.setting: A small puppet theater before the show begins.
scene.actor: One child sits watching the closed stage curtain; only one person.
beats: The child takes a seat.
The curtain remains closed while the child waits.
The child watches eagerly in expectation of the show.
scene.ending: A child leans forward toward the closed curtain, waiting for the puppet show.

artDirection: Curtain stays closed; do not reveal a puppet performance. No signs, letters, or text.

review.reviewNote: 句子自然，闭幕和等待演出表现对即将发生之事的预期。

relation: A recession is an economic slowdown that can force a factory to reduce production.
sentence: The recession forces a factory to cut production, leaving many machines idle.（经济衰退迫使工厂削减产量，许多机器因此闲置。）

scene.setting: A quiet factory floor during a downturn.
scene.actor: No person; several machines are idle and only a small stack of products remains.
props: one large factory machine switched off
a small stack of unfinished products
beats: The factory produces fewer goods.
The machine is left idle.
A reduced stack of products shows the recession’s effect.
scene.ending: An idle machine and a small amount of unfinished output sit on a quiet factory floor.

artDirection: No signs, displays, labels, text, or numbers. Keep the factory empty and subdued to suggest reduced economic activity.

review.reviewNote: 句子自然，衰退导致工厂减产的经济义准确，factory 是具体场景锚点。

relation: To clothe someone is to dress them; putting a coat on a child is a clear example.
sentence: She helps clothe her child in a warm coat before they go outside.（出门前，她帮孩子穿上暖和的外套。）

scene.setting: A warm entryway beside the front door.
scene.actor: One parent helps one child put on a warm coat; exactly two people.
beats: The child prepares to go outside.
The parent helps the child put on the coat.
The child is fully dressed for the cold weather.
scene.ending: The parent fastens the child’s coat before they leave through the door.

artDirection: Show exactly two people, each with two arms and two hands; no extra hands emerging from clothing. No lettering on clothing.

review.reviewNote: 句子自然，穿外套是 clothe（给……穿衣）的具体实例。

relation: A straight line connects two points directly without a detour.
sentence: She draws a line directly from one point to another.（她从一个点直接画线连到另一个点。）

scene.setting: A clean tabletop viewed from above.
scene.actor: No person; a pencil rests beside a simple drawing.
props: one blank sheet with two small dots
one straight line joining the dots
beats: Two points are placed on the blank sheet.
A straight line is drawn between them.
The line reaches the second point directly without turning.
scene.ending: One straight line connects two dots on a blank page.

artDirection: Show exactly two small dots and one straight connecting line; no arrows, letters, numbers, writing, or extra marks.

review.reviewNote: 句子简洁自然，直线呈现 directly 的直接、不绕行关系。

relation: A scale can be part of a respectful health check when discussing obesity.
sentence: The doctor discusses obesity as a health concern while the patient steps off the scale.（病人刚从体重秤上下来，医生便和他平和地谈起肥胖相关的健康问题。）

scene.actor: One doctor speaks supportively with one adult patient beside a plain scale; exactly two people.
props: one plain scale with a blank display
one unmarked medical chart turned face down
beats: The patient steps off the scale.
The doctor listens and discusses health without judgment.

scene.ending: A doctor speaks kindly with an adult patient beside a simple scale.

artDirection: Use a respectful, nonjudgmental medical scene; no exaggerated body features, no visible numbers, text, labels, or medical signage.

review.reviewNote: 句子自然且保持中性医疗语境；体重秤是与肥胖健康讨论相关的熟悉锚点。

relation: A storm can threaten a place by bringing wind and rain that may cause harm.
sentence: Dark storm clouds threaten the small village as heavy rain approaches.（暴雨将至，乌云笼罩着小村庄，可能带来威胁。）

scene.setting: A small village under a darkening sky.
scene.actor: No person; heavy storm clouds gather over the village.
props: one bank of dark storm clouds
beats: Clouds gather above the village.
Wind bends the tree as rain approaches.
The storm threatens the house and village.
scene.ending: Dark clouds and a bent tree loom over one small house.

artDirection: Show approaching weather, not destruction or injury. No signs, text, or extra people.

review.reviewNote: 句子通顺，暴风雨可能造成损害，真实表现 threaten 的威胁义。

relation: A museum preserves and displays objects from the past, giving a clear setting for something historical.
sentence: The museum displays a historical crown from an ancient kingdom.（博物馆里陈列着一顶古代王国留下的历史王冠。）

scene.actor: No person; one old crown sits inside a glass display case.
beats: The crown is found from an ancient time.

Visitors can see the historical crown in the museum.
scene.ending: An old crown is displayed clearly in a simple museum case.

artDirection: No visitors, labels, plaques, numbers, or writing; the crown should look old and preserved, not fantasy-themed.

review.reviewNote: 句子自然，museum 场景准确承载 historical 的历史相关义。

relation: A guard may stop a criminal who is carrying stolen property; the roles are related but not synonymous.
sentence: A plain-clothed guard stops the criminal carrying a stolen bag.（便装守卫拦住了带着赃物包袋的罪犯。）

scene.setting: A quiet city sidewalk beside a low brick wall and a simple gate.

beats: The suspect walks along the wall carrying the bag.
The guard steps out beside the gate and raises a hand to stop the suspect.
The criminal is stopped calmly without a struggle.
scene.ending: A casually dressed guard calmly stops the person with the plain bag beside the gate.

artDirection: The guard wears ordinary everyday clothing, not a uniform. No badge, shield emblem, patch, cap, ID card, logo, police equipment, weapon, writing, letters, digits, or text anywhere. Exactly two people, with normal arms and legs.

review.reviewNote: 句子自然，便装守卫与罪犯是不同角色；通过拦停携赃物者表达关系，不依赖制服文字。

relation: A warm smile is a familiar way to show a friendly attitude.

The friendly welcome puts the child at ease.
scene.ending: The neighbor smiles and offers a flower to the child by the open gate.

review.reviewNote: 句子自然，微笑是友好态度的具体外在表现。

relation: A flashlight is useful when it helps someone complete a task in the dark.

artDirection: No glowing text or symbols on the flashlight; show the beam revealing the keys clearly.

review.reviewNote: 句子通顺，手电筒在找钥匙时发挥作用，useful 的意义明确。

relation: Curly hair can be a genetic trait inherited from a parent.

props: one family photo with only the same mother and child
beats: The mother looks in the mirror with the child.
Their similar curly hair is visible.
The shared feature suggests a genetic trait passed from parent to child.
scene.ending: Mother and child stand together, their naturally curly hair clearly alike.

artDirection: Show only two people with normal arms and hands. Any family photo must contain only a simple picture with no text, borders, or extra people.

review.reviewNote: 句子自然，卷发作为从母亲遗传的特征说明 genetic 的基因义。

relation: A clock makes a solo time trial competitive by giving the runner a time to beat.
sentence: The competitive runner races against the clock to beat her personal record.（这位有竞争意识的跑者与时间赛跑，想打破自己的纪录。）

scene.ending: One runner crosses a blank finish ribbon during a solo timed race.

artDirection: Exactly one runner, with no other runners, spectators, or people. Show a solo time trial. The stopwatch has no digits or text; the finish ribbon is blank. Runner has exactly two arms and two legs.

review.reviewNote: 句子自然，clock 是单人计时赛的锚点，competitive 由争取刷新纪录体现。

relation: A visitor arrives at a place and is often first seen at the door.
sentence: A visitor knocks at the door before entering the house.（来访者进屋前先敲门。）

She waits to be welcomed inside.
scene.ending: A visitor with a small bag waits outside the closed front door.

review.reviewNote: 句子简洁自然，来访者在门外敲门，visitor 场景明确。

relation: A phone call is a familiar way to inform someone by telling them news.
sentence: She uses her phone to inform her friend that the train is delayed.（她用手机告诉朋友，火车晚点了。）
